DLC2309:4:t_018:6.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Not at all. I was merely thanking the god of battle for letting me meet warriors as strong as you.」

DLC2309:4:t_018:7.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Now I have a fine tale to bring back to Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$.」

DLC2309:4:t_018:8.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Sour grapes are rather unbecoming.」

DLC2309:4:t_018:9.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「That was not my intent. I have lost.」

DLC2309:4:t_018:12.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「As I thought, this $$アドラティオ$$ is insufficient for the way I fight!」

DLC2309:4:t_018:13.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「But now that worthy opponents like you have appeared, I should soon receive permission to use my other body!」

DLC2309:4:t_018:14.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Thank you, beast and wind! I look forward to our next battle!」

DLC2309:4:t_019:0.en:
$$ギミー$$
「What's his deal?! Acting like he's some big shot!」

DLC2309:4:t_019:2.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「$$ダバラーン・タウ$$, huh...」

DLC2309:4:t_019:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「$$尸空#keyword$$, $$バルビエル$$, $$サルディアス$$, and now $$ダバラーン$$... The Empire sure has its share of tough bastards...」

DLC2309:4:t_100:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I see! That attack lays your fighting instincts bare... You truly are a beast!」

DLC2309:4:t_100:1.en:
$$葵$$
「I'll take that as a compliment, $$ダバラーン$$!」

DLC2309:4:t_100:2.en:
$$葵$$
「And to thank you, I'll show you everything I've got!」

DLC2309:4:t_100:3.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「That is precisely what I desire! I shall make the beast submit by force!」

DLC2309:4:t_101:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Your very presence draws others in and creates a mighty surge! So you truly are a man who calls forth storms!」

DLC2309:4:t_101:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「And I'll run at the head of that storm! No matter what's waiting in my path!」

DLC2309:4:t_101:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「Here I come, $$ダバラーン$$! My drill will punch right through that absolute confidence of yours!!」

DLC2309:4:t_102:0.en:
$$くらら$$
「That team of Beastmen really gave it their all.」

DLC2309:4:t_102:1.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「At this point, it doesn't matter whether we're humans or Beastmen. This is Earth versus $$サイデリアル$$.」

DLC2309:4:t_102:2.en:
$$朔哉$$
「The resistance fighters aboard that transport will probably return to the fight, too.」

DLC2309:4:t_102:3.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Nobody has given up. Even after a defeat, they pick themselves up and challenge the enemy again.」

DLC2309:4:t_102:4.en:
$$葵$$
「Let's go, too! We're taking this planet back!!」

DLC2309:4:t_102:5.en:
$$葵$$
「Get ready, $$サイデリアル$$! Let's do this!」

DLC2309:4:t_103:0.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Everywhere you look in this world, there's fighting...」

DLC2309:4:t_103:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「It reminds me of when you and I were enemies.」

DLC2309:4:t_103:2.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「So you're used to taking on overwhelming foes.」

DLC2309:4:t_103:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「That's how I live my life.」

DLC2309:4:t_103:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「But there's nothing my drill can't pierce! No matter how big the enemy is!」

DLC2309:4:t_103:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「Let's do this! I'll keep fighting until I get $$ニア$$ back!!」

DLC2309:4:t_104:0.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「I can't lose! Not with those children waiting on $$コレハナ島$$!」

DLC2309:4:t_104:1.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「$$サイデリアル$$! For the children's future, I'm driving you off this planet!」

DLC2309:4:t_105:0.en:
$$ギミー$$
「Now that $$キタン$$'s gone, I'm $$大グレン団$$'s shock troop commander!」

DLC2309:4:t_105:1.en:
$$ギミー$$
「Here I go! He gave his life to protect Earth's future... Now it's my turn to protect it!」

DLC2309:4:t_106:0.en:
$$ダリー$$
「$$サイデリアル$$... The $$新地球皇国$$... You stole this planet's freedom and peace...!」

DLC2309:4:t_106:1.en:
$$ダリー$$
「We will never lose! $$キタン$$ protected the Earth, and now it's my turn to protect it!」

DLC2309:4:t_107:0.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We cannot end this war by fighting one local battle after another...」

DLC2309:4:t_107:2.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Our destination is the imperial capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$... correct?」

DLC2309:4:t_107:3.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Exactly. And to get there, we must win the battle before us.」

review.context: Dabalan acknowledges defeat and hints at a stronger body; battle conversations reaffirm the teams' reasons to fight.
decisions: The god of battle is a common noun, unrelated to the glossary pilot Jin.
The soldiers' beast/wind description remains a motif rather than a faction name.
